shortDescription: NetApp Element Software Manage Cluster Pair

options.name: dest_mvip
options.description: Destination IP address of the cluster to be paired.

options.name: dest_password
options.description: Destination password for the cluster to be paired. Optional if this is same as source cluster password.

options.name: dest_username
options.description: Destination username for the cluster to be paired. Optional if this is same as source cluster username.

options.name: hostname
options.description: The hostname or IP address of the SolidFire cluster. For na_elementsw_cluster, the Management IP (MIP) or hostname of the node to initiate the cluster creation from.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the specified cluster pair should exist or not.

options.name: username
options.description: Please ensure that the user has the adequate permissions. For more information, please read the official documentation U(https://mysupport.netapp.com/documentation/docweb/index.html?productID=62636&language=en-US).
